_meta.description: Free zone knowledge base. Drives free-zone ranking, cost breakdown, and visa-quota assessment in the deterministic engine. Edit this file to update pricing/rules; do not embed zone facts in code.
_meta.pricing_disclaimer: All figures are APPROXIMATE publicly-advertised package pricing for 2025/2026 and change frequently. They exclude many real-world extras (Establishment Card, e-channel/immigration registration, medical + Emirates ID per visa, deposits, activity add-ons, VAT). Always confirm a live quote with the zone authority or a licensed corporate services provider before relying on any number.

field_docs.specializations: Activity categories this zone is known for. Matched against activity.categories for ranking.
field_docs.setup_cost_aed: Approx. first-year cost for a basic licence WITHOUT visas (min-max band).
field_docs.annual_renewal_aed: Approx. yearly renewal for the licence (min-max band).
field_docs.per_visa_cost_aed: Approx. incremental government + zone cost per employment visa (min-max band), excluding the individual's medical/Emirates ID which is broadly similar across zones.
field_docs.visa_rules.flexi_desk_max_visas: Max visas typically allocated on a flexi-desk / shared-desk package with no dedicated office.
field_docs.visa_rules.sqm_per_visa: Rule-of-thumb dedicated office space (in sqm) required per additional visa once beyond the flexi-desk allocation.
field_docs.prestige: Relative brand prestige of the address (low | medium | high), used only as a tie-breaker.

free_zones.name: IFZA (International Free Zone Authority)

visa_rules.notes: Popular for cost-effective multi-visa packages without a physical office up to the flexi-desk cap.

pros: Low cost with a Dubai address

free_zones.name: SHAMS (Sharjah Media City)

visa_rules.notes: Among the cheapest entry points; base package is visa-light and best for freelancers/solo media businesses.

pros: Strong fit for media/creative and freelancers
cons: Thin visa allocation on base package

free_zones.name: Meydan Free Zone

visa_rules.notes: Central Dubai address with virtual-office packages carrying a small visa quota.

pros: Good for e-commerce and general trading
free_zones.source: Meydan Free Zone published package pricing 2025/2026 (approximate)

free_zones.name: DMCC (Dubai Multi Commodities Centre)

visa_rules.notes: Flexi-desk options exist; higher visa counts need a dedicated DMCC office in JLT/Uptown.

pros: World's most-awarded free zone; strong brand

free_zones.name: DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre)

visa_rules.notes: Regulated financial firms need physical office space; visa counts scale with leased area.

cons: Regulatory (DFSA) approval process for financial activities is demanding

free_zones.name: ADGM (Abu Dhabi Global Market)

visa_rules.notes: Financial firms require physical presence; visa allocation scales with office area.

pros: Access to Abu Dhabi capital ecosystem
cons: Abu Dhabi base may not suit Dubai-centric teams
free_zones.target_company_size: Funded fintech, asset managers, financial institutions

free_zones.name: Dubai Internet City (TECOM)

visa_rules.notes: TECOM co-working/GoFreelance options for small teams; larger visa counts need leased office.

cons: Best value only if you use the ecosystem

free_zones.name: RAKEZ (Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone)

visa_rules.notes: Cost-effective multi-visa packages; industrial land and warehousing available cheaply.

pros: Low cost for both services and industrial
cons: Ras Al Khaimah base (further from Dubai)

free_zones.name: DAFZA (Dubai Airport Free Zone)

visa_rules.notes: Premium logistics zone; visa scaling tied to office/warehouse leased area.

pros: Excellent for logistics, re-export and trade
free_zones.target_company_size: Trading and logistics firms with cargo needs

free_zones.name: Dubai South Free Zone

visa_rules.notes: Logistics-oriented; competitive packages near Al Maktoum airport and the logistics corridor.

pros: Aviation/logistics corridor around Al Maktoum airport
Good value for e-commerce and warehousing
Room to scale into industrial land
cons: Ecosystem still maturing vs central zones
